title: Signal Lost
tagline: The ping is the only way to see. It is also how they find you.
description: You are somewhere inside a dark structure with a sonar and no map. Each ping throws out a ring that paints the walls it touches and flashes anything alive back at you — and every ping tells the things in here exactly where you are. Find the way out, one careful pulse at a time, and go one level deeper.
author: HexCave
controls: WASD or arrow keys to move
howToPlay: You are in a dark maze with a sonar and no map. Move with WASD or the arrow keys; hold shift to move quietly.
Press space to ping. The ring paints every wall it touches and flashes anything alive back at you as a red blip.
Walls you have seen stay faintly visible, so the map builds up as you explore.
The ping is also a shout: anything within earshot turns and comes towards where you pinged from.
A red glow at the edge of the screen means something is close, even if you cannot see it.
Find the green exit to descend. Three touches ends the run — each one sends you back to the entrance of the floor you are on.
goal: Find the way down on each level and go as deep as you can. Your deepest floor is kept.
